messages:
nora_p: Hi team — got a surprise hospital bill for my delivery (2026-04-02). Hospital billed as out-of-network because their system had the wrong group number from my ID card. I paid the $900 facility deposit and now they sent a $6,200 balance bill. Anyone handled reprocessing when the group number was wrong at check-in?

claire_peopleops: Oh no @nora_p, congrats on the baby and sorry about the bill. Which plan are you on? If it’s a PPO we can usually get carrier to reprocess once the correct member/group is provided.

nora_p: Redwood Premier PPO. The EOB shows provider as "out-of-network" and reason code: "member not found (group mismatch)". Hospital says they used the card info scanned at registration. I have the digital card and the hospital registration form.

ben_benefits: Typical steps: 1) Ask hospital billing to re-submit claim with corrected member/group info (they may need a signed authorization). 2) If they've already closed the claim, request a reopening or void+resubmit. 3) Submit a member-initiated appeal to carrier with: itemized bill, registration form showing the scanned card details, proof of payment (deposit), and the correct member ID.

nora_p: Hospital says they can re-bill but need a signed form authorizing them to re-submit. Can People Ops provide a template?

claire_peopleops: Yep — I can post a short clinic-facing form. Also I can request a replacement ID card PDF from the carrier so you can give them the correct info. Want me to DM the template and the PDF when ready?

ben_benefits: Also note: for maternity deliveries carriers often have special inpatient case management. If you tell the carrier it was an administrative/billing error they sometimes expedite reprocessing. Ask them to route to inpatient/billing appeals.

nora_p: Please DM the template. Timeline is tight — hospital wants payment arrangements if they cant collect soon.

claire_peopleops: Sending DM now. Template (paste to give to hospital):
```
Authorization to Rebill Claim
Patient: Nora P.
Member ID: XXXXXX1234
DOB: 1992-07-14
I authorize Austin Regional Hospital to correct billing/member information and resubmit the claim to [Carrier Name] for services rendered on 2026-04-02.
Signature: ____________________
Date: _____________
```

ben_benefits: And a short appeal cover note you can submit to carrier: 
```
To: Claims Department
Re: Claim # (if known) - DOS 2026-04-02
The facility originally submitted the claim with an incorrect group number due to a registration scan error. Member paid deposit of $900 at admission (receipt attached). Please reprocess the claim with the corrected member/group number (Member ID: XXXXXX1234). Hospital will resubmit if needed.
Sincerely,
Nora P.
```

nora_p: Thanks both. @ben_benefits can you escalate to the carrier case manager once I upload everything? I want to avoid collections while they fix it.

ben_benefits: Yep I can open a carrier case once you DM me the registration form + deposit receipt + digital card. Ill ask them to hold collections and route to inpatient billing.

carrier_bot: [automated] Carrier note: When a claim is reprocessed for administrative error, allow up to 45 days for adjudication. If balance bill represents an emergency admission, include clinical notes for faster review. Link: https://carrier.example/maternity-billing

nora_p: DMd the docs to @ben_benefits and @claire_peopleops. Appreciate the quick help — will update if hospital re-bills or carrier responds. :pray:
